item.title: iNKillerPlus v448.0.0
item.description:
Instagram 448.0.0 | Instagram_448.0_iNKillerPlus_5.2
• Fixes a possible crash on rootless JB - Add alternative icon to jailbreak since iG include the icon inside the app - Fixes show app icon in settings for ios 26 - 27 as was disabled in previous versions - Fixes show email open in profiles or copied text to detect emails automaticlly - Fixes profile bio long press to copy detect email and links - Fixes read DM icon - Fixes user exception for direct message - Add full compatibility with IG v445+ - Updated base IPA to Instagram v448.0
